tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published AI tools by keyword and optional category. Matches name, description or tags. Use list_categories for valid category values. Returns source and official website URLs.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get a published tool by its exact slug, including available FAQs and source URLs. Returns found=false if unavailable.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List category values present in published tool listings. Pass a returned slug to search_tools.category.
